_notes: Our own Git-backed CMS for OSP's Dancing with the Stars 2026 page. ONE collection ('Dancing With The Stars Stars' in Webflow, id 66b90685bd1fb0490773a1e3 on site 64dc6469dc8981cbbbb73864) drives THREE on-page sections via the 'section' field: '2026-cast', '2026-staff', '2025-cast' (the 'Thank You To Our 2025 Cast' archive block). Card = photo (image-12 board-image) + name (text-block-24-copy nopad) + a 'Learn More' popup with a larger photo (image-40) + bio (cfr-staff-bio-text w-richtext). 'image' = filename in ./assets/ served locally from ./assets/ (a full http(s) URL is still accepted verbatim as a fallback). 'preview': true = preview URL only; false/omit = live in production. 'role' is optional. See ../README.md and ../../../../HYBRID-CMS.md.
_provenance: Reconciled 2026-06-26 by Studio Lead against Mat's full live-page HTML export (_source/dwtss-source.html). Roster confirmed identical to the Webflow Data-API pull: 8x 2026-cast dancers, 2x 2026-staff (Tara Faires=Artistic Director, Blake+Erica=MCs), 8x 2025-cast archive. All 18 photos downloaded to ./assets/ and served locally (2025 archive images pre-sized 1080->600px). Correction from the HTML: 4 of the 2025 cards (Jason Odell, Dr. Jesse Curran, Eva Jimenez, Christina Prosperi) carried real fundraiser-event bios on the live page that the Data-API pull had dropped; those richtext bios are restored here ahead of each card's YouTube watch link. 2026 dancers keep their donorperfect 'Support' link folded into the bio (no native button in the hybrid render).
_preview_state: Mat decision 2026-06-26: all 8 2026 dancers + 2 staff go LIVE (preview flags removed from every row). The 'Thank You To Our 2025 Cast' archive block is KEPT. No card-level support/vote button (popup 'Learn More' is sufficient).

items.name: Eva Jimenez
items.bio:
Eva's Eras Fundraiser

Raise a glass for a life-changing cause at Vintage! 🥂 Join us Thursday, September 25th from 5–8 PM at the Vintage Public House, here in Redding, to support Dancing with the Shasta Stars and One Safe Place Transitional Housing.ㅤ🍸 Try a new specialty drink: Eva’s Eras. Every sip helps provide survivors a safe place to heal, rebuild, and breathe. Come for the drinks, stay for the impact.

Orange Theory BLACKLIGHT FUNDRAISER CLASS 🧡🖤

Join us Friday, September 26TH at 5:30 PM for a special blacklight class supporting one of our very own members, Eva, as she raises money while competing in Dancing with the Shasta Stars! ✨💃All proceeds will benefit One Safe Place, supporting transitional housing for survivors of domestic abuse. A $25 donation is required to attend class - which is followed by our TORTURE THE TRAINER!! At $2 per burpee, buy burpees and assign them to your favorite coach(es) to make THEM get their burn on! 🔥🔥
